title: 『1度殻をむいた卵は食すのみ』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Camp is halfway over, and I'm currently taking Sakura Chiyono O's times, like I promised I would before summer camp started.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… What's… what was my time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look at the notes on my clipboard and compare her newest time to the past times I've recorded for her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Did I get a new PR?! Am I even faster than I was in the spring?!
choice_data_list: It's about the same as it was toward the end of last year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… It's harder to improve than I thought it would be…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creak… Crack…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It's that feeling again…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It feels like I'm getting weaker. Like I'm starting to splinter apart… I feel as if I'll never be able to return to how I was before…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …I'm scared.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If I were to race against Maruzen as I am now…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen would probably be running at the front all by herself, while I'd be watching her from the pack.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No one would be able to reach her. But as she rounded the third turn, I'd charge forward!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'd gradually ramp up to my top speed, and the distance between me and Maruzen would slowly decrease.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Then we'd hit the final stretch—and it'd be down to raw speed! I'd squeeze out every drop of strength in me and pull forward to chase after Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen would glance back at me! She'd challenge me to a one-on-one duel! And I'd push forward as hard as I could!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And the moment I go to take my next stride… my legs would give out under me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creak… Crack!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No matter how much strength I try to muster up, my weak, fading body won't be able to hold on to it… One by one, the other racers will pass me…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …And I won't reach her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ngh… There's no way I can be her rival, not like I am right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O and I are just about to start training, but she has an unusually dark expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! It's nothing that will affect training today, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Is that… a crowd?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O! Did you come to observe the match too?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ardan and Bamboo are racing against each other!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Exhale…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That was something else… How did you manage to recover so fast?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Ardan won. Bamboo's at her very peak, but Ardan still managed to defeat her, even though she's only just recovered…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Uh, congratulations, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I'm glad to be back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That feeling of regret you showed me… that passionate desire not to lose… it spurred me on and led me to this point.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That is quite a feat, Ardan. However, as I am sure you know, Chiyono O will not be defeated so easily.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Having raced against her, I am well aware of her strength. And as such, I will not lose at the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, I didn't realize you'd be running in it! Will you be there as well, Chiyono?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um… Yes, I will.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Then if I enter the autumn Tenno Sho as well, it will be just like the Derby. The three of us can race each other once more!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (I should recognize that feeling. I felt the same way myself after the Derby.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: When I finally crossed the finish line, I found myself wishing the race could've gone on longer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I wanted to fight for the lead with Yaeno and Ardan forever. I wanted to keep running until the stars burn out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… It's finally… over!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: As my body holds me back… it feels like it's even tearing those feelings out of my grasp…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Ardan is exactly the same as she was before she took her break.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …I hate this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Yaeno isn't declining either. I'm not like them.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I hate this… I hate this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (I'm not the Sakura Chiyono O who ran in the Derby anymore…)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I hate this so much!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O?!
Everyone, please give me a second. Let me talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Why? Why can't I—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Puff…
Phew, I finally caught up to you! You just kept on charging off, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen? Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Because I've been watching you, of course! I've always got my eye on you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, you really confused everyone back there, suddenly running off in the middle of talking to your friends like that. Chiyo…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …You wouldn't happen to be past your peak, would you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! How do you know that?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm… It's just a feeling, I guess. Since I've been through it too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're lying. There's no way you understand how I feel. You're always—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky! Is it true that you won your first scrimmage in a long time by seven lengths?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I saw you race. You came back from your break as if it was no big deal at all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're incredible… You've never once had to worry about whether you were in your peak or not.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I knew you were special. You're not like me. You've got extraordinary talen—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's not quite right, hon.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Do you feel like you're slowly losing yourself? Like you'll never be able to return to how you were before?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I hit the nail right on the head, didn't I? That's exactly how I felt, you see. I also tried to return to how I was back in my heyday.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But I simply couldn't. My body will never be able to go back to the condition it was in, and I can't run like I did before.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I feel pretty good! That wasn't so bad. In fact…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Even if I'm past my peak, I'm going to keep running as I am.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: There's a fire burning inside of me, fueled by the desire not to lose to my rival—and that's you, Chiyo.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Having a rival sure is something. I never would have imagined I'd hate the thought of losing so much!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Once a glass is broken, it can't go back to how it was. I knew there was no hope of restoring it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I knew what was happening, but that didn't mean I had to take it lying down! So I kept fighting and fighting until I felt like myself again.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I may not be the same "me" that I was before, but I can say with pride that I'm no lesser racer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now, dear Chiyo. Isn't your heart ablaze at the sight of me, your rival, standing in front of you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're the one who stirred that emotion to life in me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And I've proved that you can overcome what you're feeling now, so long as that feeling is alive and well in you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now then, Chiyo.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: There's a 2,400-meter turf race in Tokyo waiting for you… I'll be waiting for you. At the Japan Cup—our Derby.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'll see you there, my precious rival!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're dripping with sweat. Did you sprint all the way here?
choice_data_list: Never mind me. Are you okay?
Never mind me. Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah! I'm sorry for worrying you. But…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to run from the truth anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll likely never return to being the racer I was before.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No… it's fine. I've decided to face reality head-on.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You don't have anything to worry about, Chiyo. I have no doubt you'll be able to overcome this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I may be gradually declining…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But there are still things I must do. I'll find a new way to fight my battles. I have to!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Because I don't want to lose to my rivals!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The flickering light of the setting sun burns in Sakura Chiyono O's eyes, bright with hope and acceptance.
